text.content:
Everything a turkey needs, on one page. Chapter numbers say where each rule is in full.

Win and lose

Win: the Dinner Clock reaches 0 (Too Late) with nobody grabbed. Lose: the farmer grabs one turkey. The flock wins or loses together.

The round (Ch 3)

  1. Turkeys: each turkey takes one action, in any order. In round 1 the farmer doesn’t count, and nobody goes into the Farmhouse.
  2. Farmer: grab, walk, search, Close Calls, dog, kid. Not in round 1 (he’s indoors).
  3. End: clock −1 (0 = win; on an EVENT space, the farm event), then every turkey that isn’t Spotted gets +1 urge, then Pip’s hiccups.

The roll (Ch 3)

  • 1 white die + 1 red die per point of urge.
  • Highest white at or above the target: works. Any white 6: Great.
  • Any red 6: you gobble (once). The result comes first, then the gobble.

Boosts: +1 white die each, 3 at most

  • Knack (your card).
  • Lend a Wing: one friend in your zone, once per round, not Spotted. They roll the helper die: a 6 makes them gobble (both 6s: two gobbles).
  • Puff Up: +1 urge first. Not at urge 5, not to Gobble for a Friend.

The urge (Ch 4)

  • 0 to 5, start at 1. +1: end of round, Close Call, Puff Up, quirks, events. Apart from Puff Up and events, at most once per action, per farmer’s turn, per end of round.
  • Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather). At 5 in the farmer’s zone, his Close Call does it: Hunker Down first.

A gobble (Ch 4)

  • Say it out loud. Urge goes to 0.
  • Farmer in your zone: Spotted. Otherwise a “Huh?” token on your spot (the zone if you’re in the open).
  • Feather: cancels one gobble from the dice. Not a full-urge gobble, not one on purpose.

Actions (Ch 3)

  • Sneak: one zone along a path, then hide if there’s room. 4+ if the farmer is in or next to either zone; else 3+ into a Noisy zone; else no roll. Fail: you still go, but you’re Spotted (farmer there) or get a “Huh?” token. Great: one more zone if it needs no roll.
  • Hunker Down: hide if you can (4+ in front of the farmer, fail = Spotted), then −2 urge for you or a friend in your zone.
  • Pull a Prank: in its zone, not with the farmer there. Roll its target; tick a box (Great: two). All boxes: it happens.
  • Gobble for a Friend: a Spotted friend in or next to your zone, once per round each. Urge to 0, no red dice, 4+: they’re free. Either way you’re Spotted (farmer in your zone) or get a “Huh?” token, unless Great.
  • Scram (Spotted only, and the only thing you can do): 4+ (Hard 5+): run one zone, hide, not Spotted. Great: one more zone.
  • Let It Out: gobble on purpose. Urge to 0, “Huh?” token on your spot (or zone, if you’re in the open).

Spotted (Ch 5)

  • Your friends get one chance: the rest of this turkeys’ turn, or all of the next one if he spotted you on his turn.
  • Grabbed at the start of the farmer’s next turn if he’s still in your zone. Game over (unless the decoy is ready). If he isn’t in your zone then, you’re free.
  • Get free with Scram, or a friend’s Gobble for a Friend.

Where he goes (Ch 7)

  • The nearest “Huh?” token (newest on a tie), up to 2 zones (Hard 3). With no token, his route line in the farm table.

Hiding (Ch 5)

  • Spot 3+ ×4: roll 3+ to stay hidden when he checks it; room for 4.
  • In the open: Spotted when he searches the zone he ends in (not zones he walks through).
  • Close Call: he (or the dog) ends in your zone and you aren’t Spotted: +1 urge.
  • Next to = joined by a path. No moving between spots in one zone: Sneak out.

Run the farm by the dice. Ham it up. Chapter 7 has every step in full.

Setting up (Ch 8)

  • Clock: 16 + 1 per turkey. 2–3 turkeys −2. Easy −4, Hard +2. Puddlewick +1, Windy Ridge +1.
  • Feathers: 2. 2–3 turkeys +1. Easy +1, Hard −1.
  • Farmhouse: the farmer; the dog (Standard, Hard); the kid (5+ turkeys).
  • Turkeys: all in the Turkey Pen, urge 1. In round 1 the farmer, dog and kid don’t count.

Difficulty

  • Easy: no dog.
  • Standard: dog follows its nose on 1–2.
  • Hard: nose on 1–3; farmer runs 3 zones to a “Huh?”; Scram 5+.

The farmer’s turn (not round 1)

  1. Grab: Spotted turkeys not in his zone get away. A Spotted turkey in his zone (highest urge; tie: lowest card number): game over. Decoy ready? He grabs it, goes to the Farmhouse, clock −2, skip steps 2–4.
  2. Walk, the first that applies:
    • Detour: straight to the prank’s zone (two? the first); no search; clear its tokens; go to step 4.
    • Rake: no walking.
    • “Huh?” token: toward the nearest (newest = highest number on a tie), up to 2 zones (Hard 3), first-listed path on a tie.
    • Route: d6 on his zone’s route line (Keen Eye: already rolled). Oven: walk twice.
  3. Search (whole family: every spot): everyone in the open there is Spotted. Check the spots with tokens (a token on the zone: roll the search line too); no token: d6 on the search line. Each turkey in a checked spot rolls its cover: fail or gobble = Spotted. Clear the zone’s tokens.
  4. Close Calls: +1 urge to everyone in his zone who isn’t Spotted. Not in Keen Eye’s zone; Scaredy from next door too.
  5. Dog (Standard, Hard): d6. 1–2 (Hard 1–3): one zone toward the nearest turkey (stays if it’s there). Else roll again on its route line. Every turkey there that isn’t Spotted rolls 4+; a fail is a “Huh?” on that spot. Close Call if they haven’t had one.
  6. Kid (5+ turkeys): d6 on its route line. Anyone in the open: “Huh?” on the zone. d6 on the search line: those turkeys roll the cover; any fail, “Huh?” on that spot. No Close Calls.

End of the round

Clock −1 (0 = Too Late: the flock wins; on an EVENT space, roll the farm event). Then +1 urge for every turkey that isn’t Spotted. Then Pip rolls a red die (6 = hic! gobble).

Farm events: on or past each EVENT space (multiples of 4)

1Truck backfires: every turkey +1 urge.
2Grandma calls: farmer to the Farmhouse now.
3Whole family helps look: next turn he checks every spot in his zone.
4Steps on a rake: next turn he doesn’t walk.
5Cold gust: every turkey −1 urge.
6Oven preheated: next turn, on his route, he walks two zones.

Pranks (Ch 6)

  • Clock jumps by its number. Loud: “Huh?” on its zone. Detour: next turn, straight there, no search. Decoy: the next grab grabs it.

The ending

Too Late: roll “What’s for dinner instead?” (Ch 6). A grab: the gobbled turkey rolls its famous last gobble (Ch 5).

Say it

“Heeere, turkey turkey turkey!” · “Was that a gobble?” · “I know you’re in here…”

Butterbean 1

Bourbon Red hen

Knack: Busy Beak. +1 white die when you pull a Prank, and when the roll works it ticks two boxes.

Quirk: Chatterbox. +1 urge after any roll where you Lend a Wing, or a friend Lends you one.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Pip 2

Narragansett jake (a young male)

Knack: Soft Steps. +1 white die when you Sneak, and one Sneak can take you two zones (one roll covers both).

Quirk: Hiccups. At the end of every round, roll one red die: on a 6 you gobble (hic!).

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Duchess 3

Royal Palm hen

Knack: Still as a Stump. +1 white die when the farmer, the dog or the kid checks your spot, and your red dice don’t count on those rolls.

Quirk: Show-off. Whenever you roll a Great, you strike a pose: a “Huh?” token goes on your spot (or your zone, if you’re in the open). A pose struck while the farmer searches stays down after he clears his tokens, so he’ll be back.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Big Tom 4

Bronze tom

Knack: Big Gobble. +1 white die when you Gobble for a Friend, and you can do it from two zones away (two paths).

Quirk: Scaredy. A Close Call happens to you when the farmer or the dog ends in your zone or next to it.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Noodle 5

White Holland jake (a young male)

Knack: Quick Feet. +1 white die when you Scram, and a Scram that works can take you two zones (three on a Great).

Quirk: Restless. You can’t Hunker Down two rounds in a row.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Clementine 6

Blue Slate hen

Knack: Cool Head. Hunker Down lowers your urge, or a friend’s, by 3 instead of 2.

Quirk: Fussy. +1 urge whenever you end an action sharing a hiding spot, or another turkey squeezes into yours.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Gizmo 7

Black Spanish tom

Knack: Mother Hen. When you Hunker Down, every other turkey in your zone lowers its urge by 1 too.

Quirk: Worrywart. +1 urge whenever another turkey is Spotted.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Hazel 8

Chocolate hen

Knack: Keen Eye. From round 2, at the start of the turkeys’ turn, the Storyteller rolls the farmer’s route die and tells the flock where he’ll walk if nothing else (a detour, a rake or a “Huh?” token) decides it. If he’s moved first, read the roll on his new zone’s route line. Close Calls don’t raise the urge of turkeys in your zone.

Quirk: Jumpy. +1 urge whenever another turkey gobbles.

Start at urge 1. Red dice = your urge. Past 5: gobble, back to 0 (no Feather can stop it).

Put a coin on the starting space (Chapter 8). It moves down 1 at the end of every round, and further when a prank happens. On an EVENT space, or jumping past one, the Storyteller rolls a farm event.

TOO LATE!the flock wins

Too Late beats everything: the moment the coin reaches it, the flock wins, even in the middle of a turn.

Cut these out, or use coins and buttons. Turn a turkey face down when it’s Spotted. Put the “Huh?” tokens down in number order, so the highest number out is the newest. When the next number is already on the map, renumber the tokens there from 1 in the same order. If all 20 are down, use a coin as the newest.
